nodes.label: Bill Template Maker UI
nodes.rationale: Screenshot shows a single-page bill/invoice template editor: a top action bar (Bill Template Maker brand, Open Bill, Save Template, Save to My Templates, primary Fill & Render button, Share as .html, Load Template, Undo/Redo, Preview, Export), a horizontal tool palette, left panels (Reference Image, Grid, Document, Placeholders), a central dotted design canvas tracing a reference invoice, and right panels (Properties, Layers) above a zoom/status bar. Purpose: design bill templates by tracing a reference image, place semantic parts/fields/placeholders, then fill with data and export.

nodes.label: Tool Palette (Select, Guides, Shapes, Text, Table, Bill Part, Field, Eyedropper)
nodes.rationale: Tool set mixes geometry primitives (Line, Horizontal/Vertical Rule, Rectangle, Rounded Rect, Ellipse, Polygon, Freehand) with document-aware tools (Text, Table, Image Placeholder, Bill Part, Field) plus alignment aids (Guide H, Guide V, Eyedropper), signaling a tracing-first workflow with semantic annotation as first-class tools.

nodes.label: Design Canvas (794 x 1123 bill sheet)
nodes.rationale: A4-proportioned page (794 x 1123 px, matching status bar) on a 10px visible grid at 50% zoom; the status bar reports Objects: 0 / Selected: 0, indicating the reference image has not yet been traced into editable objects.

nodes.label: Reference Image Panel (opacity, whitening, removal)
nodes.rationale: Reference image at 25% opacity with 'Show reference' toggle and 'Whiten paper on new parts' option; text states the reference sits at the bottom layer and is excluded from JSON, SVG, PDF, DOCX and PNG exports — i.e. the reference guides tracing but never ships in output.

nodes.label: Document Panel (New blank document, Lock structure, 794 x 1123 px)
Placeholders Panel ({{token}} mechanism)
nodes.rationale: Add a {{token}} to a text box or drop in an image placeholder to make it appear in rendered output; each placeholder carries its own label, input type and printed style — tokens are the binding layer between template design and Fill & Render data.

nodes.label: Properties Panel (empty-selection state)
nodes.rationale: Copy reads 'Nothing selected. Pick an object on the canvas to edit its geometry, styling and semantic role.' — confirms selection-driven editing and that objects carry a semantic role alongside geometry and styling.

nodes.label: ACME Trading Co Invoice Reference Image
nodes.rationale: Skeleton invoice showing company header 'ACME TRADING CO / INVOICE', PO No and invoice date meta blocks, BILL TO block, a description/qty/price table with items and Subtotal/Total rows, and a footer note — the intended trace target for a complete bill template.

nodes.label: Bill Part Tool
nodes.rationale: Bill Part cuts can keep or whiten the paper's own colour; the whitening default is set in the Reference Image panel while each part keeps its own choice and can be re-cut from its Bill Part panel — parts are re-editable semantic regions of the bill.

nodes.label: {{token}} Placeholder Binding
nodes.rationale: Placeholders type their own input (label, input type, printed style), making the template self-describing so Fill & Render can prompt for or bind data without external schema.

nodes.label: Fill & Render (primary action)
nodes.rationale: Styled as the single primary (blue) button in the header, indicating the end-state of the template workflow: resolve placeholders to values and produce the rendered bill.

nodes.label: Export Pipeline (JSON, SVG, PDF, DOCX, PNG)
nodes.rationale: Export menu plus 'Share as .html' and 'Save Template' imply multiple serialization targets; the Reference Image panel explicitly excludes the reference layer from all five export formats.
